## About

::::: {.about-grid}

:::: {.about-text}

I am an interdisciplinary researcher who builds scientific tools. I am trained as a statistician, mathematician, and computer scientist. My work focuses on statistical methodology, applied data analysis, reproducible computing, and scientific software, with applications across biology, physics, engineering, and related scientific domains.

## Projects

Selected research and software projects.

::: {.cards}

::: {.card .service-card}
<p class="service-tag">Reproducibility</p>

### Reproducible research

[Everyday reproducibility](https://gjhunt.github.io/repro_course)  
A short course on practical reproducibility.

[Containerizing](https://gjhunt.github.io/containerize)  
Tools and examples for reproducible, interactive, and shareable analyses.
:::

::: {.card .service-card}
<p class="service-tag">Clinical trials</p>

### Clinical trial methods

[pgc](https://gjhunt.github.io/pgc)  
Poisson-gamma combine for clinical trials.
:::

::: {.card .service-card}
<p class="service-tag">Imaging</p>

### Image-based cell profiling

[rr](https://gjhunt.github.io/rr)  
Robust re-scaling to help reveal latent structure.

[mema_norm](https://gjhunt.github.io/mema_norm)  
Robust normalization of high-throughput imaging assays.
:::

::: {.card .service-card}
<p class="service-tag">Engineering</p>

### Hypersonics and engineering

[svsa](https://gjhunt.github.io/svsa)  
Support vector spectrum approximator for quick approximations of spectra.

[app](https://gjhunt.github.io/app)  
Adaptive pressure profile shock train tracking for dual-mode sc/ramjets.

[kars](https://gjhunt.github.io/kars)  
Kernel approximation of Raman spectra.
:::

::: {.card .service-card}
<p class="service-tag">Deconvolution</p>

### Cell-type proportion estimation

[hspe](https://gjhunt.github.io/hspe)  
Hybrid-scale proportion estimation.

[dtangle](https://gjhunt.github.io/dtangle)  
Quick and accurate cell-type deconvolution.
:::
